description: Isolith CATIA/SolidWorks editor parity baseline. Decision #19 sets the product bar: same-or-greater editor functionality than CATIA/SolidWorks for the working engineer. This register stops being an exclusion list and becomes the PARITY BASELINE inventory an engineer reads to judge whether Isolith covers their main job. Machine-checkable copy of docs/scope-register.md. Every row carries a current-status token (not-scoped / planned / building / shippable) and evidence; a row may NOT claim a status higher than a green accepted test proves (honest-claims discipline, enforced by python/oep_tooling/scope_register_check.py and tests/test_scope_register.py). Also carries the practitioner_input_contract section (schema 2): the INPUT AND BEHAVIOUR contract an experienced user carries in their hands, free-specified by the LTT practitioner test of SolidCraft and Purrametric (Don directive 2026-10-27) - one row per behaviour with an explicit test hook, under the same honest-claims status ceiling.

practitioner_input_contract.description: Editor input and behaviour contract from the LTT practitioner test of SolidCraft and Purrametric - the expectations an experienced user carries in their hands (Don directive 2026-10-27). One row per behaviour; each carries the existing register fields plus an explicit test hook, and obeys the same status ceiling: building/shippable require a green accepted test that exercises the behaviour.

rows.capability: Command search on a single key (SolidWorks S key, Fusion search) plus a keyboard reachability path to any command
rows.workstream: shell: oep-shell command surface (P7-M5 command registry, search + generated help index)

evidence.ref: crates/oep-shell/tests/practitioner_input_contract.rs
evidence.note: type-ahead search (commands::search) narrows the whole reachable command set to what matches; every command resolves through its dispatch token (validate_token) and is advertised in the generated text/markdown/JSON indexes - keyboard reachability is exercised by the command_search tests in practitioner_input_contract.rs on main

evidence.note: a right-click context surface now exists over pick/selection in the sketch editor: right-click in the viewport opens a constraint menu (H V Co Len Rm) and every entry drives the same constraints::apply path as the toolbar, asserted by the context_menu_applies_the_same_constraints_as_the_toolbar test on wave head. The radial/recent-dimension wheel styling is a later cosmetic; the context-menu seam named in the test_hook is landed.

rows.test_hook: context-wheel over pick/selection (needs a context-menu layer on the editor bar)

rows.capability: Two-axis snap inference during a drag: coincident plus midpoint and perpendicular/extension snaps

rows.test_hook: drag-snap resolver over oep-geo segment predicates (midpoint / perpendicular / extension)

rows.capability: Escape semantics: one press clears the active tool, measured and consistent

rows.test_hook: EditorSession::dismiss_active_tool + single-press consistency probe (requires an active-tool model and an escape binding)

rows.capability: Single-press undo/redo parity and a visible undo step boundary per committed dimension
